items.title: FastGPT
items.description: FastGPT is a knowledge-based question answering system built on the LLM. It offers out-of-the-box data processing and model invocation capabilities. Moreover, it allows for workflow orchestration through Flow visualization, thereby enabling complex question and answer scenarios! FastGPT 是一个基于 LLM 大语言模型的知识库问答系统，提供开箱即用的数据处理、模型调用等能力。同时可以通过 Flow 可视化进行工作流编排，从而实现复杂的问答场景！
